q1.question: What are "Data Credits"?
q1.answer:
Data Credits are the currency you use to conduct research on our platform. They are consumed in the following ways:
1. Data Usage: 1 credit is used for each row of data loaded on our "Insights" page. Loading the same row again in the same month is free.
2. Exporting Data: you can export rows you have already loaded, without extra credits, up to your plan's export limit (rows per export and rows per month).
3. No Charge: Social Listening queries do not consume Data Credits; your plan limits how many queries are active at once.
Please note: Credits and export rows reset every month (also on yearly plans). Unused credits do not roll over.

faqs.q: How much does a listing cost? Is it one-time or recurring?
faqs.a: It is a one-time payment. There is no subscription.

faqs.q: How soon will my tool go live?
faqs.a: Paid submissions skip the queue and are usually published within 48 hours.

faqs.q: Does my listing expire?
faqs.a: No. Once approved, your listing stays in the directory permanently.

faqs.q: How can I get more views?
faqs.a: Combine your listing with an ad campaign or a guest post for extra exposure.

faqs.q: Why was my tool not listed?
faqs.a: We reject tools that are unreachable, not AI-related, or that violate our content policy. You will be notified and refunded.

faqs.q: Do you guarantee traffic or sales?
faqs.a: No. We guarantee the listing and its placement, not specific traffic or revenue outcomes.

faqs.q: What is your refund policy?
faqs.a: If your tool is rejected, you get a full refund. Published listings are non-refundable.

faqs.q: Do you work with agencies?
faqs.a: Yes — contact us for bulk submissions.

faqs.a: Pick a tool and a click package. Once paid, your ads start rotating across the site until the purchased clicks are delivered.

faqs.q: Can I buy clicks more than once?

faqs.a: Buy a larger package or contact us for a custom campaign with guest posts and social promotion.

faqs.q: How do I order a guest post?
faqs.a: Buy at least 2 credits, then submit your article from your dashboard. Our editors review it before publishing.

faqs.q: How do I order a link insert?
faqs.a: Buy 1 credit per link, then send us the target URL, anchor text and the article you want it placed in (or let us pick one).

faqs.q: What does the publishing process look like?
faqs.a: Purchase credits → submit your article or link details from your dashboard → editorial review → publication. The live link appears in your dashboard (Posts / Links).

faqs.q: Are there content guidelines for guest posts?
faqs.a: Articles should be original, AI-related, useful to readers and free of spammy or adult links. We may request edits.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund for unused credits?
faqs.a: Yes. Contact support and unused credits will be refunded to the original payment method.

faqs.q: What do guest posts and link inserts do for me?
faqs.a: They put your product in front of an AI-focused audience and give you a permanent dofollow backlink.

faqs.q: Is there a bulk discount?
faqs.a: Yes — any order above {min} credits is automatically discounted by {percent}%.

faqs.q: Do you work with agencies?
faqs.a: Yes. Agencies managing multiple clients can contact us for custom arrangements.

faqPage.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about TopAICollection

0.question: What is TopAICollection?
0.answer: TopAICollection is a comprehensive directory of AI tools and websites. We help users discover the best AI solutions for their needs, from productivity tools to creative applications.

1.question: How do I find the right AI tool?
1.answer: You can browse by category, use our search function, or check our featured and trending sections. Each tool includes detailed descriptions, user reviews, and ratings to help you make an informed decision.

2.question: Is TopAICollection free to use?
2.answer: Yes! Browsing and searching our directory is completely free. Some listed tools may have their own pricing, which is clearly indicated on each tool's page.

0.question: How are tools selected for the directory?
0.answer: We carefully review each submission to ensure quality. Tools must be functional, provide value to users, and comply with our guidelines. We also consider user feedback and ratings.

1.question: What information is provided for each tool?
1.answer: Each tool listing includes a description, key features, pricing information, user reviews, traffic analytics, categories, and direct links to the tool's website.

2.question: How often is the directory updated?
2.answer: Our directory is updated daily with new tools and information. We continuously monitor listed tools to ensure accuracy and remove any that are no longer available.

0.question: How can I submit my AI tool?
0.answer: Open the Submit page, enter your tool's name and website, choose whether we write the listing or you do, then complete the one-time payment. Your tool is listed within 48 hours.

1.question: What are the requirements for tool submission?
1.answer: Your tool must be functional, provide clear value to users, have a professional website, and comply with legal requirements. We don't accept tools that promote illegal activities or violate user privacy.

2.question: How much does it cost to list a tool?
2.answer: A submission costs a one-time US$99 and the listing is permanent. Our team also adds tools we discover ourselves at no cost to their makers. Advertising and guest posts are optional paid extras.

0.question: Do I need an account to use TopAICollection?
0.answer: No account is needed to browse and search the directory. With an account you can write reviews, manage your submitted tools and GPTs, advertise, and use Website Insights and Social Listening.

1.question: How do I promote my tool?
1.answer: Go to Advertise (or Dashboard → Advertise AI) and buy a click package, Standard or Featured. Your tool then appears in sponsored spots until the clicks are used up.

2.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
2.answer: Yes. Research Plan subscriptions can be cancelled anytime from Dashboard → Payment & Invoice; you keep access until the end of the paid period. Click packages and submissions are one-time purchases.
